easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Kobolds of Kher Keep.
You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying its mana cost.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Kobolds of Kher Keep and one other creature you control, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
